name: hgi_qdq_tsplit_rslice_r2
slot_change_request: NEW leaf master of the split QUANT transport; slot in the HBM die contract requested from H-DIE (replaces the 453.6x345.6 monolith slot).

job.purpose: Native-audit successor of the closed rslice (spread 84.7 > 80 ps, launch 225.4 on 3 gx_w pins, capture 196.0 on 24 rr_w pins; R 157.5): its clock entered at the W face corner (y 10.8 um), 205 um of Manhattan reach to the far N/E flops (512 rr_w capture + 256 gx_w launch pin registers). r2 moves the clock entry to the W face centre (y 43.2) next to rsel: worst reach 173 um, symmetric N/S halves. Same RTL (pin registers already at both faces, keep_pin_regs anchors them), zero cycles.
